stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the energy systems load forecast research task. Analyzed 15-minute load data from January 1-7, 2026, imputed missing values, performed comprehensive reliability analysis, created visualizations, and produced an annual load forecast with reliability-oriented commentary. Generated a complete research report with methodology, results, figures, and operational recommendations.
